On 19 January 2025, at approximately 1400 hours local time, Wichita County Sheriff’s Office deputies responded after a passerby reported seeing a suspicious device on the bank of the Wichita River at the bridge over FM Road 369 in Wichita Falls.
Deputies used a UAS to examine the device and called the Fort Sill bomb squad, Wichita West volunteer firefighters, and a Wichita Falls police officer associated with the ATF for assistance.
The bomb squad used an X-ray to examine the device and determined that it was a live IED, described as a pipe bomb.

On 11 December 2024, at approximately 2300 hours local time, Houston Police Department’s (HPD) Northeast Crime Suppression Team attempted to conduct a traffic stop on a stolen vehicle near Tidwell Drive and Jensen Drive in Houston.

HPD’s SWAT Team arrived at the scene to assist and convinced the suspect to throw the weapons out of the car.
Investigators recovered several firearms and a small quantity of explosives from the scene.
